subject.title: feat: agregación de tiempos y productividad (a definir con devs)

question: Should Review V3 productivity aggregation be implemented as BigQuery fact/mart tables derived from orders.products[].reviewV3Session, and where should reviewerEmail be persisted for per-operator metrics?
rationale: The issue explicitly leaves the aggregation model undefined, and the current evidence shows a real contract choice between deriving from order-level reviewer data or sealing operator identity in the Review V3 session/steps.

options.title: Use BigQuery fact/mart with sealed reviewer identity
options.body: Persist reviewerEmail in the Review V3 contract, then build a step-grain fact table and daily mart without expanding opProductivity beyond compatibility reporting.

options.title: Extend opProductivity for phase analytics
options.body: Fold phase metrics into the existing productivity collection, trading faster UI reuse for a mixed operational/analytics data model.

options.title: Defer until EPIC branch lands on dev
options.body: Keep the issue open until Review V3 session code is on dev, then decide against the final merged contract.

recommendation.title: Use BigQuery fact/mart with sealed reviewer identity
recommendation.body: Persist reviewerEmail in the Review V3 contract, then build a step-grain fact table and daily mart without expanding opProductivity beyond compatibility reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the issue context and current productivity/data-platform history most directly connected to the compatibility decision.
